description:
Sr Software Engineer, iOS – 
   
 Position Summary and Responsibilities 
   
 Education/Experience 
   
 Bachelors degree in computer science, software engineering or relevant field (required) 
 5+ years experience in Software Development using Java, Objective-C, C or C++(required)
 2+ years of iOS Mobile Application Development experience. (required)
  
 Skills 
  
 Expert ability to work independently and manage one’s time. (required)
 Excellent problem solving, critical thinking, and communication skills. (required)
 Strong foundation in computer science, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms and software design optimized for mobile platform. (required).
 Design and develop native mobile applications for iOS (Apps & SDK libraries).
 Passion for user experience and knowledge of iOS Application Patterns as per the iOS Development Guidelines.
 Experience with iOS development tools (Xcode, continuous integration tools and unit testing.
 Knowledge iOS platform security practices.
 Experience using RESTful APIs to integrate mobile applications to server side systems.
 Solid coding practices including good design documentation, unit testing, source control (GIT, SVN etc) and peer code-reviews.
 Ability and desire to learn new skills and take on new initiatives.
 Proven ability to work and have fun in a team environment.
 Desired experience on Mobile Banking applications.
 Familiarity in integrating GCM notification system.
 Familiarity in design and implementation of configuration oriented Apps.
 Familiarity with Imaging API's, Remote deposit. 
 Major Job Duties and Responsibilities 
  
 Develop next generation mobile payment applications, write solid code following best development practices.
 Work as a part of scrum team executing the products requirements working with UX, product management and other teams in an agile manner.
 Provide subject matter expertise for iOS platform.
 Develop iOS framework and UI based on best practices.
 Execute POCs for visionary initiatives.
  
  
 Responsibility level 
  
 Exercises independent judgment with minimal direction from supervisor 
 

 If you're interested. please send an updated resume and the hourly /  Salary / compensation which you're expecting to Venkat at tekwissen dot com
